ALL OK

ACTION

Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and check in the "Control Units Test" ambient, "Other Systems" Assembly, "Proxi Alignment Procedure" Systems, that the "Instrument Panel Node" alignment has taken place

Move on to Step 8

2

INSTRUMENT PANEL CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that the panel installed is correct for the vehicle trim level (a panel for a petrol version cannot be fitted on a diesel version)

Move on to Step 3

Panel does not correspond with the vehicle trim level

Replace instrument panel

Op. 5560B10 CONTROL PANEL - R+R

3

CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and check, in the Instrument Panel Node ambient, that there are no errors and that the parameters are present

Move on to Step 8

1. Connection with NQS impossible

1. Move on to Step 4

2. Presence of errors

2. Move on to Step 7

4

ELECTRICAL POWER SUPPLY CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that the electrical power supply for the "Instrument Panel Node" is correct

See E4010 INSTRUMENT PANEL

Move on to Step 5

Positive and/or earth electrical power supply faulty

Renew and/or replace the defective component (in the case of a fuse, find out what caused it to blow).

5

ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the wiring/electrical connections for the Instrument Panel Node, in particular that every pin is correctly connected and fitted in place

Move on to Step 6

Wiring and/or electrical connections not working

Restore the wiring and/or damaged electrical connections

6

CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Using the Examiner, check the possibility of connecting with the Instrument Panel Node

Move on to Step 7

Impossible to connect with the control unit

Replace instrument panel

Op. 5560B10 CONTROL PANEL - R+R

7

CHECK ERRORS

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check for the presence of one or more of the following errors using the Examiner in the Instrument Panel Node ambient:

  • CAN line
  • EEPROM

Move on to Step 8

1. "No additional information" and/or "BUS off" detected

1. Continue as described by the diagnostic equipment

2. EEPROM faulty

2. Replace instrument panel

Op. 5560B10 CONTROL PANEL - R+R

8

ACTIVE DIAGNOSIS CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check, using the Examiner in active diagnosis that the autotest function is correctly activated

Move on to Step 9

The function in question is not controlled by the active diagnosis

Replace instrument panel

Op. 5560B10 CONTROL PANEL - R+R
